meta.title: Jana Samadhan - Government of Odisha
meta.description: File grievances on WhatsApp, register for Online Hearings, track status, and receive notifications — Odisha's citizen grievance redressal portal.

hero.lead: Jana Samadhan helps citizens of Odisha file grievances on WhatsApp, register for Online Hearings, and receive updates until the case is resolved — with officer accountability and clear SLAs.
hero.statusHint: Already filed? Message Status followed by your GR number on WhatsApp.
hero.mockIn: Namaste, my ration card renewal is pending at the Khordha office for 3 months.
hero.mockOut: Logged as #GR-9821. Routed to Commerce & Transport · Khordha. An officer will respond within the 48-hour SLA. You will get WhatsApp updates.

solve.label: Problem to resolution
solve.title: How Jana Samadhan solves your problem
solve.lead: From the moment you message WhatsApp to the day your case is closed, every step is tracked.
solve.p1Solution: File from home on WhatsApp in Odia, Hindi, or English — no travel, no form-filling counters.
solve.p2Solution: Get a reference ID instantly. Check status anytime by messaging Status GR-… on WhatsApp.
solve.p3Solution: Auto-routed to the right OSD desk across 30 districts with a 48-hour SLA and audit trail.
solve.p4Solution: WhatsApp alerts when your case is received, assigned, forwarded, answered, or closed.

whatsapp.label: WhatsApp grievance
whatsapp.title: How citizens file and track on WhatsApp
whatsapp.lead: A simple guided chat — no app install beyond WhatsApp, no office visit.
whatsapp.s1Body: Tap “File on WhatsApp” and start a chat with the Jana Samadhan bot.
whatsapp.s2Body: Pick Odia, Hindi, or English, then the category (Commerce & Transport, Steel & Mines, or Ganjam) and your district.
whatsapp.s3Body: Write a short description. Add photo, PDF, or video evidence if needed. Confirm your name and area.
whatsapp.s4Body: Your grievance is logged and auto-routed. Save the GR-… number for all future updates.
whatsapp.s5Body: Message Status GR-… anytime. Update open cases or list your grievances from the same chat.

hearing.label: Online Grievance Hearing
hearing.title: Register for a hearing before the Minister’s Office
hearing.lead: When a hearing is announced, register online during the open window. Screening, serial numbers, and Google Meet details come on WhatsApp.
hearing.s1Body: Visit Online Hearing to see sessions announced by the Hon’ble Minister’s Office.
hearing.s2Body: Fill personal details, department, grievance description, and optional documents during the open window.
hearing.s3Body: PS / OSD officers screen registrations. Selected citizens receive a serial number.
hearing.s4Body: Meeting link and hearing-day details are sent to your WhatsApp before the session.

notifications.label: Notifications
notifications.title: Stay informed without chasing offices
notifications.lead: Every important milestone is pushed to your registered WhatsApp number.
notifications.exampleBody: “Your grievance #GR-9821 has been forwarded to the concerned department. You will be notified when they respond.”

services.label: Platform services
services.title: Everything Jana Samadhan offers citizens
services.lead: One portal for filing, hearings, tracking, and accountability across Odisha.
services.s1Body: Guided filing in Odia, Hindi & English with photo, PDF, and video attachments.
services.s2Body: Check any case, add updates to open grievances, or list all your filings from chat.
services.s3Body: Register for Minister’s Office hearings and attend via Google Meet with WhatsApp updates.
services.s4Body: Automatic alerts at every milestone — from receipt to resolution and hearing selection.
services.s5Body: Commerce & Transport, Steel & Mines, and Ganjam District — routed to the right officers.
services.s6Body: Response deadlines, breach alerts, and escalation so cases do not sit idle.
services.s7Body: Departments acknowledge and act on tokenized portal links — every step stays on record.
services.s8Body: Journey timeline from filing to closure — accountability that outlasts transfers.
services.b1: No office visit required to file
services.b5: Hear your case before the Minister’s Office
services.desksLead: Your grievance is routed to the correct Operational Support Desk.

minister.label: Message from the Honourable Minister
minister.quote: “Every citizen of Odisha deserves to be heard. Jana Samadhan brings grievance redressal to your WhatsApp — transparent routing, timely responses, and Online Hearings so that no voice is lost between offices. Use this platform with confidence; we are accountable to you.”

cta.label: Ready to begin?
cta.title: File today. Track every step. Get heard.
cta.lead: Citizens use WhatsApp and Online Hearing to file, track, and resolve grievances.
